entities.name: Charlotte Froese Fischer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Charlotte Froese Fischer was a Canadian-American applied mathematician, computer scientist and physicist noted for the development and implementation of the Multi-Configurational Hartree–Fock (MCHF) approach to atomic-structure calculations and its application to the description of atomic structure and spectra.
